product_one_liner.value: Kojo helps trade and self-perform contractors manage construction-material procurement, inventory, purchase orders and invoice workflows in one platform.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes included capabilities and offers a custom quote rather than numeric prices.

employee_band.notes: Reported workforce count: 160; employee counts are estimates.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog contains company, industry and product posts; no qualifying pair of engineer-authored how-built posts was established.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists Demand Gen Lead and Revenue Operations Support Analyst; neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.value: OpenAI GPT-4 and Hugging Face transformer models
model_provider.notes: Explicit disclosure for Kojo Intelligence Layer; it does not establish the provider behind every current AI feature.

last_funding.notes: September 2025 financing; the later Business Wire announcement is dated October 16, 2025. Amount is the extension, not the cumulative Series C total.

raised_18mo.notes: The $10 million Series C extension in 2025 falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Neither of the two live board titles qualifies. Search-indexed SDR/AE listings were not verifiably live.

launched_6mo.notes: A May 19, 2026 event publicly introduced the new Access Coins Evo + Kojo integration and said it was available now. The integration had also been announced on the blog on April 28; this answer counts the dated May introducing event under the requested announcement criterion, not as proof its first availability was in May.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: In January/February 2026, Maria Davidson moved from CEO to Executive Chair and Micah Rodman succeeded her as CEO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live Revenue Operations Support Analyst post names Salesforce and DocuSign; the historical Director of Revenue Operations posting names Outreach, Gong and HubSpot in its preferred tools stack. The historical post is not evidence of a current opening.
